target.name: focal departure from collective defensive motion
target.definition: For focal outfield defender d, r_d(t) = x_d(t) - c_{-d}(t), where c_{-d}(t) is the centroid of the other available defending outfield players.
interpretation: not responsibility, attention, tactical error, or relational reconfiguration by itself

data.held_out_rule: No focal-relative quantity or outcome may be inspected on Sample Game 2 before this protocol is committed and execution is explicitly authorized.

identities.outfield_set: non-goalkeeper player identities with complete x/y throughout the interval

sampling.grid: non-overlapping five-second grid; first start in each period is the smallest elapsed-match multiple of five not before period tracking begins
sampling.possession: latest PASS, RECOVERY, SET PIECE, or SHOT team at interval start; exclude any interval in which that event-defined team changes
sampling.interval_length_rationale: Five seconds matches the previously used primary diagnostic scale, is long enough to contain coordinated movement, and remains short relative to most uninterrupted possessions; it is frozen before held-out focal outcomes.

smoothing.method: centered rolling arithmetic mean applied separately to x and y within each interval
smoothing.edge_handling: no padding; first and last three frames have no smoothed value and are omitted from path accumulation
smoothing.missing_coordinates: no interpolation; interval/focal eligibility is resolved before smoothing

descriptors.primary: focal_relative_path_length_m = sum of Euclidean increments of smoothed r_d(t)
descriptors.primary_rationale: Path length preserves accumulated relative movement that can cancel in endpoint changes and directly measures movement relative to the leave-one-out baseline. It is not interpreted as meaningful departure without activity/context diagnostics.

activity_conditioning.cut_source: Sample Game 1 conditioning variables only; no focal-relative outcome
activity_conditioning.warning: Contemporaneous conditioning is descriptive, not causal, and must not be described as estimating an activity-free effect.

validation.description: Estimate Game 1 focal-relative distributions and activity-context relationships, then evaluate their direction, magnitude compatibility, and shape in untouched Game 2.
validation.secondary_diagnostic: defender-within-team contrasts within the same interval, restricted to defenders with at least 50 eligible intervals; no role inference

not_primary.activity_conditioned_distribution: incorporated as context but cannot alone establish meaning
not_primary.within_defender_temporal: secondary only because substitutions leave uneven support

summaries: separate Spearman relationships with each activity variable
3x3 focal-absolute-path by collective-path cell medians and IQRs
validation.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap by five-second interval; 10000 resamples; seed 20260829

support.stop_rule: Do not execute if recomputation from checksummed raw files fails any criterion; do not alter criteria after focal outcomes are viewed.

negative_controls.common_translation_invariance: Apply an identical observed translation trajectory to every defender from fixed initial relative positions; focal-relative path must be zero up to numerical tolerance. This is a calculation/invariance check, not empirical evidence.

temporally_misaligned_collective_referen.rule: Replace the contemporaneous collective reference with the nearest eligible non-overlapping interval from the same period, defending team, and Game-1-frozen collective-activity tercile, 10-120 seconds away; earlier time wins ties.
temporally_misaligned_collective_referen.interpretation: Tests whether contemporaneous collective alignment contains information beyond a similarly active but temporally unrelated reference; it is not a tactical null.

negative_controls.player_identity_permutation: rejected because permuting all focal identities within the same team/interval only relabels the complete defender distribution and destroys legitimate identity/role structure without a clear null

requirements: Game 2 support criteria pass before outcomes
overall and activity-cell distribution shapes are reported in both matches
at least seven of nine primary activity cells have an absolute Game-2-minus-Game-1 median difference no greater than 0.5 pooled within-cell IQR, with interval-cluster bootstrap uncertainty reported
the directions of separately reported activity relationships do not materially reverse
effect-size compatibility and uncertainty are considered; identical estimates and statistical significance are not required
5/7/9-frame and 4/5/6-second sensitivities preserve the qualitative conclusion

falsification: focal-relative path is almost completely determined by focal absolute activity, operationalized as absolute Spearman rho >=0.95 in both matches with no stable conditional variation
collective, ball, or aggregate activity accounts for all reproducible contextual structure
Game 1 contextual relationships materially fail or reverse in held-out Game 2
player identity or unobserved role dominates so strongly that no match-replicating primitive remains
missingness or substitution patterns make leave-one-out membership unstable or violate support
the qualitative result changes across frozen 4/5/6-second or 5/7/9-frame sensitivities
leave-one-out centroid gives misleading behavior under common rotations, compression, or asymmetric deformation
the quantity has no soccer interpretation beyond 'this defender moved differently'
scope_exclusions: model fitting, clustering, HMM, network analysis, or ML
